source_model.zero_flux_single_species_condition: dn/dz+n*d(lnT)/dz=0, hence nT constant and p constant for ideal gas

kinetic_reference.zero_flux_condition: p/sqrt(T) constant in ideal fully thermalized free molecular limit
kinetic_reference.limitation: Actual wall scattering/surface adsorption can give departures; not all real pores obey ideal limit.

scope: Algebraic source-closure limit comparison for model selection, not a full implementation or a claim that the entire source theory is false. No coefficients fitted to force agreement.
